coordinate_convention.heading: outward; 0 degrees north, clockwise in plan view
coordinate_convention.slope: outward rise/run at the edge; percent = 100 * grade

piece.purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for DD RHW-4 — L1/L2 ↔ RHW-4 L0 — Orthogonal Transition — Lower Deck Bends Right — 6 Tiles.
piece.name: DD RHW-4 — L1/L2 ↔ RHW-4 L0 — Orthogonal Transition — Lower Deck Bends Right — 6 Tiles
piece.description: Viewed from the stacked end looking downhill, the lower road curves one tile right as it reaches ground, and the upper road descends on the original centreline. The lower road carries two lanes downhill, and the upper road carries two lanes uphill. Both join native RHW-4.

engineering.cross_section_policy: Flat horizontal normal sections; true lane-speed curvature compensation
engineering.lower_grade_scope: Sampled two-lane chords at 0.25 m stations
engineering.atlas_alpha_blend: One minus cubic smoothstep of deck height divided by 0.25 m
engineering.datum_transition: Native DD offset times remaining deck-height fraction; exact zero at ground
engineering.tile_clipping_policy: At most 1e-9 m input grid snap; exact half-space classification and bounded segment intersections
engineering.support_geometry_scope: Closed oriented rectangular piers and caps; structural capacity unverified
engineering.native_uv_reflection_policy: Reflect exact source lateral XYZ and its affine UV field before the physical shape reflection; phase longitudinal samples by traffic direction
engineering.atlas_uv_policy: Source-normal atlas pixels with one canonical lateral UV reflection
engineering.model_winding_policy: Reverse canonical reflected barrier winding and each whole-world reflected triangle separately
engineering.support_coordinate_policy: Upper supports use the straight deck frame; lower supports follow the curved lower deck frame
engineering.underside_policy: Paired roof triangulation, clipped at exact 1 m roof height; underside is clamped to ground

provenance.geometry: Measured orthogonal native DD and RHW-4 sockets, a lower road with a 16 m lateral shift, and an upper road with a straight descent.
provenance.construction: Twelve row-major tile owners, all-corner flat-base constraints, three optional unowned native sockets, and four proper rotations.
provenance.granularity: One coordinated reusable adapter with shared starting space and three complete native boundaries.

connections.purpose: Intrinsic saved-resource endpoints, service roles, directed journeys, and forbidden transfers for one piece.

source.scope: one piece only; no counterpart catalogue is consulted
source.construction_basis: Actual emitted per-piece rule sections from the independently verified saved build
